scoring_justification: Headline numeric results (adsorption energy, O–O bond lengths) are compared against paper-reported values with tolerances that absorb legitimate DFT toolchain spread; bond elongation and qualitative charge analysis are structurally verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for adsorption energy, O-O bond lengths, and charge analysis quality checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: adsorption energy -1.57 eV (Eq.1 and conclusion), O-O bond lengths 1.35 before and 1.44 after adsorption (Fig.7(b) text), charge redistribution description (Section 3.7.1).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's DFT results section and figure captions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published computational results; the hidden gold mirrors the correct reproduction target.

outputs.description: Qualitative charge redistribution evidence from the bare heterojunction. Verified for non-empty, internally consistent description.
Quantitative adsorption results: adsorption energy and O–O bond length change, compared to paper-reported values.

output_contract.notes: The slab optimization (step_1) is a required process step and not scored. The charge analysis is structural; the adsorption values are compared to paper gold with tolerances.
